title: The irreducibility of consciousness has no mysterious source

statements.text: Consciousness fails to be reducible not because of a mysterious feature but because it falls outside the pattern of reduction chosen for pragmatic reasons. Before theory, consciousness is a surface feature of certain physical systems like solidity, and a future revolution in the idea of reduction cannot be ruled out.

sources.locator: p. 7, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, pp. 122-124
sources.quote: falls outside the pattern of reduction that we have chosen to use for pragmatic reasons
